all_rules.Rule_Description: At program startup, the system captures today's calendar date and today's Julian date (YYDDD format) to be used later for authorization expiry calculations.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program CBPAUP0C is initializing
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program reads input parameters
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must accept PRM-INFO from SYSIN containing: P-EXPIRY-DAYS (number of days after which an authorization is considered expired), P-CHKP-FREQ (how often to take a checkpoint), P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ (how often to display checkpoint progress messages), and P-DEBUG-FLAG (whether debug logging is enabled), and display the received parameters

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Input Parameters from SYSIN
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program reads its runtime control parameters from the SYSIN input stream, including expiry days threshold, checkpoint frequency, checkpoint display frequency, and debug flag.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has read the input parameters from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The value of P-EXPIRY-DAYS is evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If P-EXPIRY-DAYS is numeric, set WS-EXPIRY-DAYS to the value of P-EXPIRY-DAYS; if P-EXPIRY-DAYS is NOT numeric, set WS-EXPIRY-DAYS to 5 (default of 5 days)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Expiry Days When Parameter Is Non-Numeric
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the expiry days parameter received from input is not a valid numeric value, the system defaults to 5 days as the authorization expiry threshold.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has read the input parameters from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The value of P-CHKP-FREQ is evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If P-CHKP-FREQ is spaces, zero, or low-values, set P-CHKP-FREQ to 5; otherwise retain the provided value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Checkpoint Frequency When Parameter Is Missing or Zero
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the checkpoint frequency parameter is missing, blank, zero, or contains low-values, the system defaults to taking a checkpoint every 5 summary records processed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has read the input parameters from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The value of P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ is evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ is spaces, zero, or low-values, set P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ to 10; otherwise retain the provided value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Checkpoint Display Frequency When Parameter Is Missing or Zero
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the checkpoint display frequency parameter is missing, blank, zero, or contains low-values, the system defaults to displaying a checkpoint progress message every 10 checkpoints.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has read the input parameters from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The value of P-DEBUG-FLAG is evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If P-DEBUG-FLAG is not equal to 'Y', set P-DEBUG-FLAG to 'N'; if P-DEBUG-FLAG is 'Y', retain it as 'Y'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Debug Flag When Not Explicitly Enabled
all_rules.Rule_Description: Debug logging is only active when explicitly set to 'Y'. Any other value causes the debug flag to be forced to 'N', ensuring debug output is not inadvertently produced.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is processing pending authorization summary records from the PAUTSUM0 IMS segment
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A successful read of the next summary record occurs (database status is blank/spaces)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Mark the database as NOT end-of-database, increment WS-NO-SUMRY-READ by 1, increment WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT by 1, and store PA-ACCT-ID into WS-CURR-APP-ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Next Pending Authorization Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program sequentially retrieves the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the IMS database segment PAUTSUM0, tracking the count of records read and the current account being processed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is reading Pending Authorization Summary records from the PAUTSUM0 IMS segment
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database read returns a 'GB' (end of database) status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Set the END-OF-AUTHDB flag to TRUE, which causes the main processing loop to terminate and the program to proceed to final checkpoint and reporting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect End of Authorization Database During Summary Read
all_rules.Rule_Description: When there are no more Pending Authorization Summary records to process, the program recognizes the end of the authorization database and stops the main processing loop.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is processing child Authorization Detail records under the current Pending Authorization Summary from the PAUTDTL1 IMS segment
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A successful read of the next detail record occurs (database status is blank/spaces)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Set MORE-AUTHS flag to TRUE and increment WS-NO-DTL-READ by 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Next Pending Authorization Detail Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each Authorization Summary record, the program sequentially retrieves child Authorization Detail records from the PAUTDTL1 IMS segment, tracking the count of detail records read.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is reading child Authorization Detail records from the PAUTDTL1 IMS segment under the current summary
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database read returns a 'GE' (segment not found) or 'GB' (end of database) status
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Set the NO-MORE-AUTHS flag to TRUE, which causes the detail processing loop to terminate and the program to proceed to evaluate the Summary record for deletion

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect No More Detail Records Under Current Summary
all_rules.Rule_Description: When there are no more Authorization Detail records under the current Summary record, the program stops the detail processing loop and evaluates whether the Summary record should be deleted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Detail record has been read with PA-AUTH-DATE-9C containing the stored complemented authorization date
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The expiry check is performed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Calculate WS-AUTH-DATE = 99999 minus PA-AUTH-DATE-9C to recover the actual Julian authorization date

all_rules.Rule_Name: Convert Stored Authorization Date to Comparable Julian Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization date stored in the database is in an inverted/complemented format. It must be converted back to an actual Julian date before the age of the authorization can be calculated.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: WS-AUTH-DATE has been calculated as the actual Julian authorization date and CURRENT-YYDDD holds today's Julian date
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The expiry check is performed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Calculate WS-DAY-DIFF = CURRENT-YYDDD minus WS-AUTH-DATE to determine the number of days since the authorization was created

all_rules.Rule_Name: Calculate Age of Authorization in Days
all_rules.Rule_Description: The age of an authorization is determined by computing the difference in days between today's Julian date and the authorization's actual Julian date.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: WS-DAY-DIFF has been calculated as the age of the authorization in days and WS-EXPIRY-DAYS holds the configured expiry threshold
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The age of the authorization is compared to the expiry threshold
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If WS-DAY-DIFF is greater than or equal to WS-EXPIRY-DAYS, set QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE to TRUE; if WS-DAY-DIFF is less than WS-EXPIRY-DAYS, set NOT-QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE to TRUE and retain the record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine if Authorization Detail Qualifies for Deletion
all_rules.Rule_Description: An Authorization Detail record is eligible for deletion if its age in days meets or exceeds the configured expiry days threshold. Records that are still within the threshold are retained.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Detail record has been determined as qualified for deletion
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization response code PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE is equal to '00' (approved)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Subtract 1 from PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT on the Summary record and subtract PA-APPROVED-AMT from PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT on the Summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Summary Approved Count and Amount for Expired Approved Authorization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an expired authorization detail record was originally approved (response code '00'), the parent Summary record's approved authorization count and approved amount must be decremented to reflect the removal.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Detail record has been determined as qualified for deletion
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization response code PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE is NOT equal to '00' (declined or other non-approved status)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Subtract 1 from PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT on the Summary record and subtract PA-TRANSACTION-AMT from PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT on the Summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Summary Declined Count and Amount for Expired Declined Authorization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an expired authorization detail record was originally declined or had any response code other than '00', the parent Summary record's declined authorization count and declined amount must be decremented to reflect the removal.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Detail record has been qualified for deletion and the Summary counts and amounts have been updated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The deletion of the Authorization Detail record from PAUTDTL1 is successful (database status is blank/spaces)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Increment WS-NO-DTL-DELETED by 1 to track the total number of detail records deleted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Delete Expired Authorization Detail Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the Summary counts and amounts have been updated, the expired Authorization Detail record is physically removed from the PAUTDTL1 IMS segment and the deleted detail counter is incremented.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All Authorization Detail records under the current Pending Authorization Summary have been processed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The remaining authorization counts on the Summary record are evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT is less than or equal to 0 AND PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT is less than or equal to 0 (note: as coded, both conditions reference PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT; business intent is that both approved and declined counts are zero or less), proceed to delete the Summary record; otherwise retain the Summary record and proceed to checkpoint check

all_rules.Rule_Name: Evaluate Whether Authorization Summary Record Should Be Deleted
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all detail records under a Summary have been processed, the program evaluates whether the Summary record has any remaining active authorizations. If both the approved and declined counts are zero or less, the Summary record is eligible for deletion.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary record has been determined to have no remaining active authorizations (both counts are zero or less)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The deletion of the Authorization Summary record from PAUTSUM0 is successful (database status is blank/spaces)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Increment WS-NO-SUMRY-DELETED by 1 to track the total number of summary records deleted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Delete Authorization Summary Record When No Remaining Authorizations
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record has no remaining active authorizations (both approved and declined counts are zero or less), the Summary record is physically removed from the PAUTSUM0 IMS segment.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been fully processed (details evaluated, summary deletion check completed)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT is greater than P-CHKP-FREQ
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Invoke checkpoint processing (9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT) and reset WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT to 0; if WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT is not greater than P-CHKP-FREQ, skip checkpoint and proceed to read the next summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Trigger Checkpoint Based on Summary Records Processed Count
all_rules.Rule_Description: To preserve processing progress, a checkpoint is triggered after the number of summary records processed exceeds the configured checkpoint frequency threshold.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A checkpoint has been triggered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The checkpoint is taken successfully (database status is blank/spaces)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Increment WS-NO-CHKP by 1; if WS-NO-CHKP is greater than or equal to P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ, reset WS-NO-CHKP to 0 and display the message 'CHKP SUCCESS: AUTH COUNT - ' followed by WS-NO-SUMRY-READ and ', APP ID - ' followed by WS-CURR-APP-ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Take IMS Checkpoint and Display Progress at Configured Intervals
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a checkpoint is taken, the program saves its processing state. A progress message showing the total summaries read and the current Account ID is displayed every P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ checkpoints.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has successfully initialized and read the first Pending Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The main processing loop is active
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Continue processing summary records and their child detail records until either an error flag is set (ERR-FLG-ON) or the end of the authorization database is reached (END-OF-AUTHDB); for each summary, process all child detail records in an inner loop until NO-MORE-AUTHS is set

all_rules.Rule_Name: Iterate Through All Summary and Detail Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program processes all Pending Authorization Summary records and their associated Detail records in a nested loop structure until all records have been evaluated or an error occurs.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The main processing loop has ended because the end of the authorization database has been reached or an error flag is set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program proceeds to finalization
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Invoke checkpoint processing (9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT) unconditionally before displaying the final report

all_rules.Rule_Name: Take Final Checkpoint After All Records Are Processed
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all Pending Authorization Summary records have been processed and the main loop has ended, a final checkpoint is always taken to preserve the completed processing state.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The final checkpoint has been taken and the program is completing execution
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program reaches the final reporting step
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Display the following four totals: '# TOTAL SUMMARY READ  :' followed by WS-NO-SUMRY-READ, '# SUMMARY REC DELETED :' followed by WS-NO-SUMRY-DELETED, '# TOTAL DETAILS READ  :' followed by WS-NO-DTL-READ, and '# DETAILS REC DELETED :' followed by WS-NO-DTL-DELETED, enclosed within separator lines

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Final Processing Summary Report
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the end of the program, a summary report is displayed showing the total counts of summary and detail records that were read and deleted during the processing run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Pending Authorization Cleanup Program (CBPAUP0C) is starting execution
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program begins its initialization phase
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program must capture today's calendar date into CURRENT-DATE and today's Julian date (in YYDDD format) into CURRENT-YYDDD from the system, so that authorization expiry age calculations can be performed accurately

all_rules.Rule_Name: Capture System Date and Julian Date at Program Startup
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the start of the program, the current calendar date and the current Julian date (YYDDD format) are captured from the system. These dates are used throughout the program to calculate the age of authorization records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has captured today's date and is proceeding with initialization
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program reads the input parameter record from SYSIN into PRM-INFO
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program must load the following four control parameters from PRM-INFO: (1) P-EXPIRY-DAYS — the number of days threshold for authorization expiry, (2) P-CHKP-FREQ — how frequently (in number of summary records processed) a checkpoint should be taken, (3) P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ — how frequently (in number of checkpoints taken) a checkpoint progress message should be displayed, and (4) P-DEBUG-FLAG — whether debug-level logging should be active during processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Runtime Input Parameters from SYSIN
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program reads four runtime control parameters from the SYSIN input stream: the number of days after which an authorization is considered expired, the frequency at which checkpoints are taken, the frequency at which checkpoint progress messages are displayed, and a debug logging flag.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has read the input parameters from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The initialization phase continues
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program must display: (1) the message 'STARTING PROGRAM CBPAUP0C::', (2) a separator line, (3) the label 'CBPAUP0C PARM RECEIVED :' followed by the full contents of PRM-INFO, and (4) the label 'TODAYS DATE :' followed by the value of CURRENT-YYDDD

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Program Start Banner and Received Parameters
all_rules.Rule_Description: Upon startup, the program displays a confirmation banner showing the program name, the full parameter string received from SYSIN, and today's Julian date, providing an audit trail of the execution context.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has read the input parameters from SYSIN and P-EXPIRY-DAYS has been populated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program validates the expiry days parameter
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If P-EXPIRY-DAYS contains a valid numeric value, then that value must be moved into WS-EXPIRY-DAYS and used as the expiry threshold for all authorization age comparisons; If P-EXPIRY-DAYS is not numeric (e.g., blank or contains non-numeric characters), then WS-EXPIRY-DAYS must be set to the default value of 5 days

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate and Default the Authorization Expiry Days Parameter
all_rules.Rule_Description: The expiry days parameter controls how old (in days) an authorization must be before it is eligible for deletion. If the provided value is a valid number, it is used as-is. If it is not numeric (e.g., blank, non-numeric characters), the program defaults to 5 days to ensure the cleanup process always has a valid threshold.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The expiry days parameter has been validated and set, and P-CHKP-FREQ has been populated from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program validates the checkpoint frequency parameter
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If P-CHKP-FREQ is equal to SPACES, or equal to 0, or equal to LOW-VALUES, then P-CHKP-FREQ must be set to the default value of 5; If P-CHKP-FREQ contains any other valid non-zero, non-blank value, it must be retained as provided

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Default Value for Checkpoint Frequency When Not Provided
all_rules.Rule_Description: The checkpoint frequency parameter controls how many authorization summary records are processed between each checkpoint save. If this parameter is missing, blank, zero, or contains low-values, the program defaults to a frequency of 5 to ensure checkpoints are taken at regular intervals.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The checkpoint frequency parameter has been validated and set, and P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ has been populated from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program validates the checkpoint display frequency parameter
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ is equal to SPACES, or equal to 0, or equal to LOW-VALUES, then P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ must be set to the default value of 10; If P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ contains any other valid non-zero, non-blank value, it must be retained as provided

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Default Value for Checkpoint Display Frequency When Not Provided
all_rules.Rule_Description: The checkpoint display frequency parameter controls how many checkpoints are taken before a progress message is displayed. If this parameter is missing, blank, zero, or contains low-values, the program defaults to a display frequency of 10 to ensure progress is reported at reasonable intervals.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The checkpoint display frequency parameter has been validated and set, and P-DEBUG-FLAG has been populated from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program validates the debug flag parameter
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If P-DEBUG-FLAG is exactly equal to 'Y', then debug mode is active and P-DEBUG-FLAG must remain as 'Y', enabling detailed debug messages to be displayed during processing; If P-DEBUG-FLAG contains any value other than 'Y' (including blank, 'N', or any other character), then P-DEBUG-FLAG must be explicitly set to 'N' and debug mode must remain inactive

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate and Enforce Debug Flag Setting
all_rules.Rule_Description: The debug flag controls whether detailed debug-level log messages are displayed during processing. The only valid value to activate debug mode is the character 'Y'. Any other value — including blank, 'N', or any other character — must result in debug mode being explicitly turned off by setting the flag to 'N'.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has received the input parameters from SYSIN, including the Expiry Days parameter (P-EXPIRY-DAYS)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program evaluates whether the Expiry Days parameter contains a valid numeric value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Expiry Days parameter is numeric, it is accepted and used as the authorization expiry threshold (WS-EXPIRY-DAYS); if the Expiry Days parameter is non-numeric or missing, the expiry threshold is defaulted to 5 days

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate and Default Expiry Days Parameter
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates the Expiry Days input parameter to ensure it is a numeric value. If valid, the provided value is used as the authorization expiry threshold. If invalid or non-numeric, the system defaults to 5 days to ensure the purge process always has a valid expiry threshold.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has received the Expiry Days parameter (P-EXPIRY-DAYS) from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Expiry Days parameter is confirmed to be a valid numeric value
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The provided Expiry Days value is stored as the active expiry threshold (WS-EXPIRY-DAYS) and will be used to evaluate whether each authorization record has expired

all_rules.Rule_Name: Use Provided Expiry Days Value
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Expiry Days parameter is confirmed to be a valid numeric value, the program accepts and applies it as the working expiry days threshold for determining which authorization records are eligible for deletion.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has received the Expiry Days parameter (P-EXPIRY-DAYS) from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Expiry Days parameter is found to be non-numeric, blank, or missing
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The expiry threshold (WS-EXPIRY-DAYS) is set to the default value of 5 days, and this default value will be used to evaluate whether each authorization record has expired

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Expiry Days to 5 When Parameter is Non-Numeric
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Expiry Days parameter is absent, blank, or contains a non-numeric value, the system enforces a business default of 5 days as the expiry threshold. This ensures the authorization purge process always operates with a valid expiry period even when the parameter is not properly supplied.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has received the Checkpoint Frequency parameter (P-CHKP-FREQ) from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program evaluates whether the Checkpoint Frequency parameter is blank, zero, or uninitialized (low-values)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Checkpoint Frequency is blank, zero, or uninitialized, it is defaulted to 5 (a checkpoint is taken after every 5 summary records processed); if the Checkpoint Frequency contains a valid non-zero value, the provided value is used as-is

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate and Default Checkpoint Frequency Parameter
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates the Checkpoint Frequency parameter to ensure it contains a meaningful value. If the parameter is blank, zero, or contains low-values (empty/uninitialized), the system defaults to a frequency of 5, meaning a checkpoint is taken after every 5 authorization summary records are processed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has received the Checkpoint Frequency parameter (P-CHKP-FREQ) from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Checkpoint Frequency parameter is found to be blank, zero, or uninitialized (low-values)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Checkpoint Frequency (P-CHKP-FREQ) is set to the default value of 5, meaning the program will save its progress after processing every 5 authorization summary records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Checkpoint Frequency to 5 When Parameter is Missing or Zero
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Checkpoint Frequency parameter is not properly supplied (blank, zero, or uninitialized), the system enforces a business default of 5. This ensures that progress is saved at regular intervals during the authorization purge process even when the parameter is not explicitly configured.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has received the Checkpoint Display Frequency parameter (P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ) from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program evaluates whether the Checkpoint Display Frequency parameter is blank, zero, or uninitialized (low-values)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Checkpoint Display Frequency is blank, zero, or uninitialized, it is defaulted to 10 (a progress message is displayed after every 10 checkpoints); if the Checkpoint Display Frequency contains a valid non-zero value, the provided value is used as-is

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate and Default Checkpoint Display Frequency Parameter
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates the Checkpoint Display Frequency parameter to ensure it contains a meaningful value. If the parameter is blank, zero, or uninitialized, the system defaults to 10, meaning a checkpoint progress message is displayed after every 10 checkpoints taken.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has received the Checkpoint Display Frequency parameter (P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ) from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Checkpoint Display Frequency parameter is found to be blank, zero, or uninitialized (low-values)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Checkpoint Display Frequency (P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ) is set to the default value of 10, meaning the program will display a progress message showing the total summaries read and the current Account ID after every 10 checkpoints

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Checkpoint Display Frequency to 10 When Parameter is Missing or Zero
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Checkpoint Display Frequency parameter is not properly supplied (blank, zero, or uninitialized), the system enforces a business default of 10. This ensures that operational progress messages are displayed at regular intervals during the authorization purge process.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has received the Debug Flag parameter (P-DEBUG-FLAG) from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program evaluates whether the Debug Flag parameter is explicitly set to the value 'Y'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Debug Flag is 'Y', debug logging is enabled and the program will display additional processing details during execution; if the Debug Flag is any value other than 'Y', it is overridden and set to 'N', disabling debug logging

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate and Default Debug Flag Parameter
all_rules.Rule_Description: Validates the Debug Flag parameter to determine whether debug logging should be enabled during the authorization purge process. Debug mode is only activated when the flag is explicitly set to 'Y'; any other value results in debug mode being turned off.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has received the Debug Flag parameter (P-DEBUG-FLAG) from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Debug Flag parameter is confirmed to be exactly 'Y'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Debug mode is enabled (P-DEBUG-FLAG remains 'Y'), and the program will display additional diagnostic messages during processing, including the current count of authorization summary records read, the current count of authorization detail records read, and the Account ID when detail or summary records are being deleted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Enable Debug Mode When Debug Flag is Explicitly Set to Y
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Debug Flag parameter is explicitly set to 'Y', the program operates in debug mode, producing additional informational messages during processing such as the count of summary and detail records read at each step, and the Account ID being processed during deletions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has received the Debug Flag parameter (P-DEBUG-FLAG) from SYSIN
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Debug Flag parameter is any value other than 'Y' (including blank, uninitialized, or any other character)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Debug Flag is overridden and set to 'N', disabling all debug logging; the program will not display additional diagnostic messages during processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Debug Flag to Off When Not Explicitly Enabled
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Debug Flag parameter is not explicitly set to 'Y' (including when it is blank, set to any other character, or uninitialized), the system enforces debug mode as OFF. This prevents unintended verbose logging in production environments.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization database contains pending authorization summary records and the program is in an active processing state (not at end of database and no error condition exists)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program requests the next pending authorization summary record sequentially from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next pending authorization summary record is retrieved and made available for processing, containing the account ID and associated authorization summary data

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Retrieval of Next Pending Authorization Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program sequentially retrieves the next pending authorization summary record from the authorization database to begin processing its associated authorization details.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A sequential read request has been made for the next pending authorization summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The record is retrieved successfully from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The total summary records read counter is incremented by 1, the summary records processed counter (used for checkpoint frequency tracking) is incremented by 1, the current account ID is saved from the retrieved summary record's account ID field, and the database status is marked as active (not end of database)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Successful Summary Record Read - Increment Counters and Track Account
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a pending authorization summary record is successfully retrieved, the program updates tracking counters and records the current account being processed, and marks the database as still having active records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A sequential read request has been made for the next pending authorization summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No more pending authorization summary records exist in the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The database status is marked as 'End of Authorization Database Reached', which causes the main processing loop to terminate and proceed to final checkpoint and reporting steps

all_rules.Rule_Name: End of Authorization Database Detection
all_rules.Rule_Description: When there are no more pending authorization summary records to retrieve, the program recognizes the end of the authorization database and signals the main processing loop to stop.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is configured with the debug flag set to 'Y'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program is about to retrieve the next pending authorization summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A debug message is displayed showing the current total count of authorization summary records read so far

all_rules.Rule_Name: Debug Logging of Summary Read Count
all_rules.Rule_Description: When debug mode is active, the program logs the current count of summary records read before each retrieval attempt, providing a trace of processing progress.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully read and is currently being processed, and the system is positioned to read its child Authorization Detail records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system requests the next child Authorization Detail record associated with the current Pending Authorization Summary
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the next Authorization Detail record (from PAUTDTL1) that belongs to the current Authorization Summary, making its data (including authorization date, response code, approved amount, and transaction amount) available for expiry evaluation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Next Pending Authorization Detail Record for Current Summary
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each Pending Authorization Summary being processed, the system must retrieve the next associated Authorization Detail record in sequence. This ensures all individual authorization transactions belonging to the current account summary are evaluated one at a time for expiry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has requested the next child Authorization Detail record for the current Authorization Summary
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved from the database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system increments the Detail Records Read Counter by 1, reflecting the total number of Authorization Detail records that have been retrieved during this program execution

all_rules.Rule_Name: Track Successfully Retrieved Authorization Detail Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time an Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved, the system must increment the running total of detail records read. This counter is used for reporting purposes at the end of the program to show total detail records processed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has requested the next child Authorization Detail record for the current Authorization Summary
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved from the database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the processing flag to 'More Authorizations Available', indicating that the detail processing loop should continue and the retrieved record should be evaluated for expiry

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Availability of More Authorization Detail Records for Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved, the system must signal that more detail records are available, allowing the processing loop to continue evaluating authorization detail records under the current summary.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has requested the next child Authorization Detail record for the current Authorization Summary
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database indicates there are no more child Authorization Detail records associated with the current Authorization Summary (end of children reached or no qualifying child record found)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the processing flag to 'No More Authorizations', causing the Authorization Detail processing loop to terminate for the current Summary, and control passes to the evaluation of whether the Authorization Summary record should be deleted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Signal End of Authorization Detail Records for Current Summary
all_rules.Rule_Description: When there are no more child Authorization Detail records under the current Authorization Summary, the system must signal the end of detail processing for that summary. This causes the detail processing loop to exit so the system can evaluate whether the Summary record itself should be deleted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has requested the next child Authorization Detail record for the current Authorization Summary identified by Account ID
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The retrieval of the Authorization Detail record fails due to an unexpected error (not a normal end-of-children condition)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system logs an Authorization Detail read failure message, logs the Account ID of the Authorization Summary being processed, logs the total number of Authorization Detail records successfully read prior to the failure, and immediately terminates the program abnormally to prevent further processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Handle Unexpected Failure When Reading Authorization Detail Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: If an unexpected error occurs while attempting to retrieve an Authorization Detail record (other than a normal end-of-children condition), the system must immediately stop processing, log the affected account and the number of detail records read so far, and terminate the program to prevent data corruption or incomplete processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been retrieved and contains a stored authorization date value (PA-AUTH-DATE-9C) in complemented format
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes the authorization detail record to evaluate its age
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The actual authorization date (WS-AUTH-DATE) is calculated as 99999 minus the stored date value (PA-AUTH-DATE-9C), converting the complemented date back to its true Julian date representation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Convert Stored Authorization Date to Actual Julian Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: The authorization date is stored in an inverted/complemented format in the database. To obtain the actual Julian date of the authorization, the stored date value must be subtracted from 99999.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current Julian date (CURRENT-YYDDD) is available and the actual authorization date (WS-AUTH-DATE) has been derived from the stored complemented date value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether the authorization has exceeded its allowed retention period
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The day difference (WS-DAY-DIFF) is calculated as the current Julian date (CURRENT-YYDDD) minus the actual authorization date (WS-AUTH-DATE), representing the number of days the authorization has been on record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Calculate Age of Authorization in Days
all_rules.Rule_Description: The age of an authorization is determined by computing the number of days elapsed since the authorization was created, using the current Julian date and the converted actual authorization date.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The day difference (WS-DAY-DIFF) representing the age of the authorization has been calculated, and the configured expiry days threshold (WS-EXPIRY-DAYS) is available (defaulting to 5 days if not provided as a valid numeric parameter)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system compares the authorization age against the expiry threshold
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the day difference is greater than or equal to the configured expiry days threshold, the authorization detail record is marked as Qualified for Deletion; otherwise, if the day difference is less than the threshold, the record is marked as NOT Qualified for Deletion and no further action is taken on that record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine if Authorization Has Expired and Qualifies for Deletion
all_rules.Rule_Description: An authorization detail record is considered expired and eligible for deletion when the number of days since its creation meets or exceeds the configured expiry days threshold. Records that have not yet reached the threshold are retained.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been marked as Qualified for Deletion, and the authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) on the detail record is '00', indicating the authorization was approved
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to remove the expired approved authorization detail record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Approved Authorization Count (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT) on the parent Authorization Summary record is decremented by 1, and the Approved Authorization Amount (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT) on the parent Authorization Summary record is reduced by the approved amount (PA-APPROVED-AMT) associated with this authorization detail record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Summary Approved Counts and Amounts When an Approved Authorization Expires
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an expired authorization detail record is identified as having been originally approved (response code '00'), the parent Authorization Summary record must be updated to reflect the removal of this approved authorization by reducing both the approved count and the approved monetary amount.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been marked as Qualified for Deletion, and the authorization response code (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE) on the detail record is any value other than '00', indicating the authorization was declined or resulted in a non-approval outcome
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to remove the expired declined authorization detail record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Declined Authorization Count (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT) on the parent Authorization Summary record is decremented by 1, and the Declined Authorization Amount (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT) on the parent Authorization Summary record is reduced by the transaction amount (PA-TRANSACTION-AMT) associated with this authorization detail record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Summary Declined Counts and Amounts When a Declined Authorization Expires
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an expired authorization detail record is identified as having been declined or non-approved (response code other than '00'), the parent Authorization Summary record must be updated to reflect the removal of this declined authorization by reducing both the declined count and the declined monetary amount.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been retrieved and its age in days (WS-DAY-DIFF) has been calculated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The day difference is less than the configured expiry days threshold (WS-EXPIRY-DAYS)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The authorization detail record is marked as NOT Qualified for Deletion, no changes are made to the Approved Authorization Count, Approved Authorization Amount, Declined Authorization Count, or Declined Authorization Amount on the parent Summary record, and the record is preserved in the database

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retain Authorization Detail Record That Has Not Yet Expired
all_rules.Rule_Description: An authorization detail record whose age in days is less than the configured expiry threshold is considered still active and must be retained. No updates are made to the parent Summary record counts or amounts for such records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been identified as expired (its age in days is greater than or equal to the configured expiry days threshold)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The authorization response code on the detail record is evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the response code equals '00', the authorization is classified as an Approved transaction and the approved summary counters are updated; if the response code is any value other than '00', the authorization is classified as a Declined transaction and the declined summary counters are updated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Classify Expired Authorization as Approved or Declined Based on Response Code
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an authorization detail record is identified as expired, the program determines whether it was an approved or declined transaction by evaluating the authorization response code, in order to update the correct set of summary counters and amounts.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been identified as expired and its response code equals '00' indicating an approved transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The summary counts are being updated to reflect the removal of this expired approved authorization
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Approved Authorization Count on the parent Authorization Summary record is decremented by 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Decrement Approved Authorization Count in Summary for Expired Approved Authorization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an expired authorization detail record is confirmed as an approved transaction (response code = '00'), the total count of approved authorizations on the parent summary record must be reduced by one to reflect the removal of this record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been identified as expired, its response code equals '00' indicating an approved transaction, and the Approved Authorization Count on the summary has already been decremented by 1
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The summary amounts are being updated to reflect the removal of this expired approved authorization
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Approved Amount from the expired authorization detail record is subtracted from the Total Approved Authorization Amount on the parent Authorization Summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reduce Total Approved Authorization Amount in Summary for Expired Approved Authorization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an expired authorization detail record is confirmed as an approved transaction (response code = '00'), the total approved authorization amount on the parent summary record must be reduced by the approved amount of this specific authorization detail record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been identified as expired and its response code is any value other than '00' indicating a declined or non-approved transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The summary counts are being updated to reflect the removal of this expired declined authorization
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Declined Authorization Count on the parent Authorization Summary record is decremented by 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Decrement Declined Authorization Count in Summary for Expired Declined Authorization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an expired authorization detail record is confirmed as a declined or non-approved transaction (response code is not '00'), the total count of declined authorizations on the parent summary record must be reduced by one to reflect the removal of this record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record has been identified as expired, its response code is any value other than '00' indicating a declined or non-approved transaction, and the Declined Authorization Count on the summary has already been decremented by 1
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The summary amounts are being updated to reflect the removal of this expired declined authorization
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Amount from the expired authorization detail record is subtracted from the Total Declined Authorization Amount on the parent Authorization Summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reduce Total Declined Authorization Amount in Summary for Expired Declined Authorization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an expired authorization detail record is confirmed as a declined or non-approved transaction (response code is not '00'), the total declined authorization amount on the parent summary record must be reduced by the transaction amount of this specific authorization detail record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An authorization detail record for a specific Account ID has been identified as expired and qualified for deletion from the Pending Authorization Detail segment (PAUTDTL1)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to delete the expired pending authorization detail record for the current Account ID from the Pending Authorization Details store
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The expired pending authorization detail record is permanently removed from the Pending Authorization Detail store (PAUTDTL1) for the current Account ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Delete Expired Pending Authorization Detail Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an authorization detail record has been identified as expired and qualified for deletion, the system must remove it from the Pending Authorization Detail store for the current account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An expired pending authorization detail record for the current Account ID has been submitted for deletion from the Pending Authorization Detail store
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The deletion of the authorization detail record completes successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The total count of deleted authorization detail records (WS-NO-DTL-DELETED) is incremented by 1 to reflect the successful removal

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Detail Deleted Counter on Successful Deletion
all_rules.Rule_Description: Upon successful deletion of an expired authorization detail record, the program must track the total number of detail records deleted during the current execution run by incrementing a running counter.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An expired pending authorization detail record for the current Account ID has been submitted for deletion from the Pending Authorization Detail store
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The deletion of the authorization detail record does not complete successfully (deletion status is not blank/spaces)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program displays a deletion failure message 'AUTH DETAIL DELETE FAILED' along with the affected Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID), and the program immediately terminates with a return code of 16, halting all further authorization cleanup processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Terminate Program on Authorization Detail Deletion Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the deletion of an expired authorization detail record fails for any reason, the program must immediately report the failure identifying the affected Account ID and terminate processing to prevent data inconsistency.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All authorization detail records for a pending authorization summary have been processed, and the approved authorization count (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT) on the summary record reflects the remaining active approved authorizations after any expired records were removed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the approved authorization count on the summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the approved authorization count is greater than zero (still has active approved authorizations), skip the summary deletion and proceed to the checkpoint check; if the approved authorization count is zero or less, proceed to evaluate the declined authorization count

all_rules.Rule_Name: Check Approved Authorization Count Before Summary Deletion
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all authorization detail records under a pending authorization summary have been processed, the system evaluates whether the approved authorization count has been reduced to zero or below, indicating no remaining approved authorizations exist for the account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The approved authorization count on the pending authorization summary has been confirmed as zero or less, and the declined authorization count (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT) reflects the remaining active declined authorizations after any expired records were removed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the declined authorization count on the summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the declined authorization count is greater than zero (still has active declined authorizations), skip the summary deletion and proceed to the checkpoint check; if the declined authorization count is also zero or less, proceed to delete the parent summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Check Declined Authorization Count Before Summary Deletion
all_rules.Rule_Description: After confirming the approved authorization count is zero or less, the system further evaluates whether the declined authorization count has also been reduced to zero or below, confirming that no remaining authorizations of any type exist for the account summary.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All authorization detail records under a pending authorization summary have been processed, the approved authorization count is zero or less, and the declined authorization count is also zero or less, indicating no active authorizations of any type remain for the account
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to delete the parent pending authorization summary record from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The parent authorization summary record is successfully removed from the authorization database; if the deletion fails, the program reports the failure along with the Account ID and terminates abnormally

all_rules.Rule_Name: Delete Parent Authorization Summary Record When No Active Authorizations Remain
all_rules.Rule_Description: When both the approved and declined authorization counts on a pending authorization summary are zero or less — meaning all authorization detail records have been expired and removed — the parent summary record itself must be deleted from the authorization database to maintain data integrity and eliminate empty summary records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A pending authorization summary record has been successfully deleted from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system confirms the deletion was successful
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The summary deleted counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-DELETED) is incremented by 1, and this updated count will be included in the final program execution report displaying total summary records deleted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Summary Deleted Counter After Successful Summary Deletion
all_rules.Rule_Description: Upon successful deletion of a pending authorization summary record, the program increments the running total of deleted summary records, which is used for final reporting at the end of the program run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is actively processing Authorization Summary records in the main processing loop, and a checkpoint frequency threshold (P-CHKP-FREQ) has been configured (defaulting to 5 if not provided or invalid)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The count of Authorization Summary records processed since the last checkpoint (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) exceeds the configured checkpoint frequency threshold (P-CHKP-FREQ)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Checkpoint processing is triggered: the program initiates a checkpoint to save current processing progress, and after the checkpoint completes successfully, the summary processed counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) is reset to zero to begin counting toward the next checkpoint interval

all_rules.Rule_Name: Checkpoint Frequency Threshold Triggers Progress Save
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines when checkpoint processing should be triggered based on the number of Authorization Summary records processed since the last checkpoint.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Checkpoint processing has been triggered either by the frequency threshold being exceeded during the main processing loop, or at the end of all processing as a final mandatory checkpoint
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program attempts to save the current processing progress using a checkpoint identified by WK-CHKPT-ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current processing state is saved; if the checkpoint completes successfully, processing continues with the checkpoint display counter being incremented; if the checkpoint fails, an error message is displayed showing the checkpoint failure status, the total number of Authorization Summary records read so far, and the current Account ID, and the program abends with return code 16

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Processing Progress via Checkpoint
all_rules.Rule_Description: Saves the current state of processing progress at configured intervals to allow recovery from failures without reprocessing all records from the beginning.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A checkpoint has been attempted to save current processing progress
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The checkpoint operation does not complete successfully (checkpoint status is not blank/spaces)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program displays an error message containing: the text 'CHKP FAILED: DIBSTAT - ', the checkpoint failure status code, the total number of Authorization Summary records read (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ), and the current Account ID (WS-CURR-APP-ID); the program then sets return code to 16 and terminates immediately

all_rules.Rule_Name: Checkpoint Failure Causes Program Abend
all_rules.Rule_Description: Enforces that any failure during checkpoint processing results in immediate program termination to prevent data integrity issues from unrecoverable processing states.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A checkpoint has completed successfully (checkpoint status is blank/spaces)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The checkpoint success is confirmed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The checkpoint display counter (WS-NO-CHKP) is incremented by 1 to track the number of successful checkpoints since the last progress display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Checkpoint Display Counter After Successful Checkpoint
all_rules.Rule_Description: Tracks the number of successful checkpoints taken since the last progress display message, to control how frequently checkpoint progress information is shown.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A checkpoint has completed successfully and the checkpoint display counter (WS-NO-CHKP) has been incremented, and a checkpoint display frequency threshold (P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ) has been configured (defaulting to 10 if not provided or invalid)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The checkpoint display counter (WS-NO-CHKP) is evaluated against the configured display frequency threshold (P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the checkpoint display counter is greater than or equal to the display frequency threshold, a progress message is displayed and the display counter is reset to zero; if the checkpoint display counter is less than the display frequency threshold, no message is displayed and processing continues silently

all_rules.Rule_Name: Checkpoint Display Frequency Threshold Evaluation
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether a checkpoint progress message should be displayed to operators based on how many checkpoints have been taken since the last display, controlled by a configurable display frequency parameter.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A checkpoint has completed successfully and the checkpoint display counter (WS-NO-CHKP) has reached or exceeded the configured display frequency threshold (P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The display frequency threshold is met
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The checkpoint display counter (WS-NO-CHKP) is reset to zero, and a progress message is displayed containing: the text 'CHKP SUCCESS: AUTH COUNT - ', the total number of Authorization Summary records read so far (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ), the text ', APP ID - ', and the current Account ID being processed (WS-CURR-APP-ID)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Checkpoint Progress Information and Reset Display Counter
all_rules.Rule_Description: Provides operational visibility into processing progress by displaying key metrics at configured intervals when the checkpoint display frequency threshold is reached.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A checkpoint has been successfully taken during the main processing loop (not the final end-of-program checkpoint)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The checkpoint processing completes (regardless of whether a display message was shown)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Authorization Summary processed counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) is reset to zero, and the main processing loop continues with reading the next Authorization Summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset Summary Processed Counter After Checkpoint
all_rules.Rule_Description: Resets the Authorization Summary processed counter after each checkpoint so that the next checkpoint interval is measured from the current position, not cumulatively from the start.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The main processing loop has completed because either all Authorization Summary records have been read (end of authorization database) or an error condition was encountered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program exits the main processing loop
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A final mandatory checkpoint is taken unconditionally to save the completed processing state; if successful, the program proceeds to display the final processing summary report; if the checkpoint fails, an error message is displayed showing the failure status, total summaries read, and current Account ID, and the program abends with return code 16

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mandatory Final Checkpoint at End of All Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: Ensures that a final checkpoint is always taken after all Authorization Summary records have been processed, guaranteeing that the completed processing state is saved regardless of whether the frequency threshold was reached.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization database contains Pending Authorization Summary records to be processed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The processing loop begins and the program requests the first Pending Authorization Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program retrieves the first Pending Authorization Summary record, increments the Summary records read counter by 1, increments the Summary processing counter by 1, stores the Account ID of the retrieved record as the current Account ID being processed, and marks the database status as 'not end of database'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read First Pending Authorization Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program initiates processing by reading the first available Pending Authorization Summary record from the authorization database to begin the cleanup cycle.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has attempted to read the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database signals that no more Pending Authorization Summary records exist
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program marks the status as 'end of authorization database' and exits the main processing loop, proceeding to take a final checkpoint and display summary counts

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect End of All Pending Authorization Summary Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each attempt to read a Pending Authorization Summary record, the program determines whether all summary records have been processed to decide whether to continue or end the processing loop.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved and the program is ready to process its child Authorization Detail records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program requests the first Authorization Detail record belonging to the current Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program retrieves the first Authorization Detail record under the current Summary, increments the Detail records read counter by 1, and marks the status as 'more authorizations exist'; if no detail records exist under the current summary, the status is marked as 'no more authorizations'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read First Authorization Detail Record for Current Summary
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each Pending Authorization Summary record retrieved, the program reads the first associated Authorization Detail record to begin evaluating individual authorizations under that account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has attempted to read the next Authorization Detail record under the current Pending Authorization Summary
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The database signals that no more Authorization Detail records exist under the current Summary (either no child records found or end of children reached)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program marks the status as 'no more authorizations', exits the detail processing loop for the current Summary, and proceeds to evaluate whether the Summary record itself should be deleted

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect No More Detail Records for Current Summary
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each attempt to read an Authorization Detail record, the program determines whether all detail records under the current Summary have been processed to decide whether to continue the detail loop or evaluate the Summary record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved, the stored authorization date is available in complemented format (PA-AUTH-DATE-9C), today's date is available in Julian format (YYDDD), and the expiry days threshold is set (defaulting to 5 days if not provided)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program calculates the authorization age by first converting the stored date using the formula: Actual Authorization Date = 99999 minus PA-AUTH-DATE-9C, then calculating the age in days as: Day Difference = Current Julian Date (YYDDD) minus Actual Authorization Date
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the calculated Day Difference is greater than or equal to the expiry days threshold, the authorization is marked as 'Qualified for Deletion'; if the Day Difference is less than the expiry days threshold, the authorization is marked as 'Not Qualified for Deletion' and is retained without any changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Check if Authorization Detail Record is Expired
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each Authorization Detail record retrieved, the program calculates the age of the authorization in days by converting the stored authorization date and comparing it to today's date against the configured expiry threshold.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The age of the Authorization Detail record has been calculated as the difference between today's Julian date and the converted authorization date
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program evaluates whether the calculated age in days is greater than or equal to the configured expiry days threshold
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the age is greater than or equal to the expiry threshold, the authorization is marked as 'Qualified for Deletion' and processing continues to update summary counts and delete the record; if the age is less than the expiry threshold, the authorization is marked as 'Not Qualified for Deletion', no updates or deletions are performed, and the program reads the next detail record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Expiry Qualification for Authorization Detail Deletion
all_rules.Rule_Description: After calculating the age of an Authorization Detail record, the program decides whether the record meets the expiry criteria and should be deleted or retained.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Detail record has been determined as expired and qualified for deletion, and the authorization response code on the detail record is '00' (indicating the authorization was Approved)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program processes the approved expired authorization before deleting it
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program subtracts 1 from the Approved Authorization Count (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT) on the Summary record, and subtracts the Approved Amount (PA-APPROVED-AMT) from the Approved Authorization Amount (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT) on the Summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Summary Approved Counts and Amounts for Expired Approved Authorization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an expired Authorization Detail record was originally approved (response code '00'), the program reduces the Approved Authorization Count and Approved Authorization Amount on the parent Summary record to reflect the removal of this authorization.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Detail record has been determined as expired and qualified for deletion, and the authorization response code on the detail record is any value other than '00' (indicating the authorization was Declined or had a non-approval outcome)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program processes the declined expired authorization before deleting it
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program subtracts 1 from the Declined Authorization Count (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT) on the Summary record, and subtracts the Transaction Amount (PA-TRANSACTION-AMT) from the Declined Authorization Amount (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT) on the Summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Summary Declined Counts and Amounts for Expired Declined Authorization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an expired Authorization Detail record was originally declined or had a non-approved response (response code other than '00'), the program reduces the Declined Authorization Count and Declined Authorization Amount on the parent Summary record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An Authorization Detail record has been confirmed as expired and qualified for deletion, and the Summary counts and amounts have been updated accordingly
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program executes the deletion of the expired Authorization Detail record from the database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Authorization Detail record is permanently removed from the database, and the deleted detail records counter is incremented by 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Delete Expired Authorization Detail Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the parent Summary counts and amounts have been updated, the expired Authorization Detail record is physically removed from the authorization database.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current Authorization Detail record has been processed (either deleted as expired or retained as not expired) and the detail processing loop is continuing
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program requests the next Authorization Detail record belonging to the current Summary record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If a next detail record exists, it is retrieved, the Detail records read counter is incremented by 1, and the status is marked as 'more authorizations exist'; if no further detail records exist under the current Summary, the status is marked as 'no more authorizations' and the program exits the detail loop to evaluate the Summary record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Next Authorization Detail Record for Current Summary
all_rules.Rule_Description: After processing (either deleting or retaining) an Authorization Detail record, the program reads the next detail record under the current Summary to continue the detail processing loop.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All Authorization Detail records under the current Pending Authorization Summary have been processed (either deleted as expired or retained as not expired), and the Approved Authorization Count (PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT) and Declined Authorization Count (PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT) on the Summary record reflect the updated state after all deletions
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program evaluates the remaining authorization counts on the Summary record: Approved Authorization Count is less than or equal to zero AND Declined Authorization Count is less than or equal to zero
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If both counts are zero or less, the Summary record is considered to have no remaining active authorizations and is qualified for deletion; the program proceeds to delete the Summary record. If either count is greater than zero, the Summary record still has active authorizations and must be retained; the program skips deletion and proceeds to the checkpoint evaluation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Evaluate Whether Authorization Summary Record Should Be Deleted
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all Authorization Detail records under a Summary have been processed, the program evaluates whether the Summary record has any remaining active authorizations. If both the Approved and Declined authorization counts are zero or less, the Summary record is no longer needed and should be deleted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Pending Authorization Summary record has been evaluated and both the Approved Authorization Count and Declined Authorization Count are zero or less, indicating no remaining active authorizations exist under this account summary
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program executes the deletion of the Pending Authorization Summary record from the database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Pending Authorization Summary record is permanently removed from the database, and the deleted summary records counter is incremented by 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Delete Pending Authorization Summary Record with No Remaining Authorizations
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record has no remaining active authorizations (both approved and declined counts are zero or less), the Summary record is permanently removed from the authorization database.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been fully processed (all its detail records evaluated and the summary itself either deleted or retained), and the Summary processing counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) tracks the number of summaries processed since the last checkpoint
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program compares the Summary processing counter against the configured checkpoint frequency threshold (P-CHKP-FREQ, defaulting to 5 if not provided)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Summary processing counter exceeds the checkpoint frequency threshold, the program takes a checkpoint and resets the Summary processing counter to zero before reading the next Summary record; if the counter has not exceeded the threshold, the program proceeds directly to read the next Summary record without taking a checkpoint

all_rules.Rule_Name: Evaluate Checkpoint Frequency Threshold
all_rules.Rule_Description: After processing each Pending Authorization Summary record (and optionally deleting it), the program checks whether the number of summary records processed since the last checkpoint has reached the configured checkpoint frequency threshold.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Summary processing counter has exceeded the configured checkpoint frequency threshold (P-CHKP-FREQ)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program executes a checkpoint to save the current processing state
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The checkpoint is successfully recorded, the Summary processing counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) is reset to zero, the checkpoint counter (WS-NO-CHKP) is incremented by 1, and if the checkpoint counter reaches or exceeds the checkpoint display frequency (P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ), a progress message is displayed showing the total number of Summary records read and the current Account ID, and the checkpoint display counter is reset to zero

all_rules.Rule_Name: Take Checkpoint and Reset Processing Counter
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the checkpoint frequency threshold is reached, the program saves its current processing progress and resets the counter to ensure regular checkpointing continues throughout the run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current Pending Authorization Summary record and all its associated Authorization Detail records have been fully processed, and the checkpoint evaluation has been completed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program requests the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the authorization database
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If a next Summary record exists, it is retrieved, the Summary records read counter is incremented by 1, the Summary processing counter is incremented by 1, the current Account ID is updated to the new record's Account ID, and the status is marked as 'not end of database'; if no more Summary records exist, the status is marked as 'end of authorization database' and the main processing loop terminates

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Next Pending Authorization Summary Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: After completing all processing for the current Pending Authorization Summary record (detail evaluation, optional summary deletion, and optional checkpoint), the program reads the next Summary record to continue the main processing loop.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All Pending Authorization Summary records have been processed and the program has reached the end of its processing cycle
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The final summary report is being generated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The total count of Pending Authorization Summary records read (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) during the entire program run must be displayed in the final report

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Total Authorization Summary Records Read
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the end of all authorization cleanup processing, the program reports the total number of Pending Authorization Summary records that were read during the run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All Pending Authorization Summary records have been processed and the program has reached the end of its processing cycle
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The final summary report is being generated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The total count of Pending Authorization Summary records deleted (WS-NO-SUMRY-DELETED) during the entire program run must be displayed in the final report

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Total Authorization Summary Records Deleted
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the end of all authorization cleanup processing, the program reports the total number of Pending Authorization Summary records that were deleted because they had no remaining active authorizations.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All Pending Authorization Detail records have been processed and the program has reached the end of its processing cycle
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The final summary report is being generated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The total count of Pending Authorization Detail records read (WS-NO-DTL-READ) during the entire program run must be displayed in the final report

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Total Authorization Detail Records Read
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the end of all authorization cleanup processing, the program reports the total number of Pending Authorization Detail records that were read across all Summary records during the run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All Pending Authorization Detail records have been evaluated for expiry and the program has reached the end of its processing cycle
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The final summary report is being generated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The total count of expired Pending Authorization Detail records deleted (WS-NO-DTL-DELETED) during the entire program run must be displayed in the final report

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Total Authorization Detail Records Deleted
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the end of all authorization cleanup processing, the program reports the total number of expired Pending Authorization Detail records that were deleted during the run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The authorization cleanup program CBPAUP0C has completed processing all Pending Authorization Summary and Detail records and a final checkpoint has been successfully taken
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program reaches its end after all records have been processed
